subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should Microsoft ecosystem triage live as a repository-generated tracker, as a maintained PR-body checklist, or remain in existing GitHub labels/search and ClawSweeper reports?
rationale: The predecessor was never merged, and this branch introduces a durable repository artifact plus a competing PR-body workflow; code review cannot establish the canonical maintainer process or ongoing owner without explicit intent.

options.title: Use existing tracking surfaces
options.body: Keep Microsoft triage in GitHub labels, searches, and ClawSweeper reports instead of adding another generated inventory and mutable PR body.

options.title: Keep only the PR-body tracker
options.body: Preserve the living checklist in this draft PR body and remove the repository file, generator artifact workflow, and changelog entry.

options.title: Adopt a repository tracker
options.body: Make the generated file canonical, remove PR-body mutation, document ownership, add a check mode, and repair the correctness findings before merge.

recommendation.title: Use existing tracking surfaces
recommendation.body: Keep Microsoft triage in GitHub labels, searches, and ClawSweeper reports instead of adding another generated inventory and mutable PR body.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS and recent repository workflow history make @steipete the strongest available owner for deciding whether this new maintainer process belongs in the repository.
